entries.answer:
Íme egy használható, részletes image-to-prompt leírás a képedhez:

**Prompt:**

A candid selfie taken inside a modern car with a panoramic sunroof, shot from a low upward angle. The composition is off-center and slightly cropped, showing only the right half of a young man’s face on the right edge of the frame. He has light skin, dark eyebrows, short facial stubble, and a neutral expression, wearing a black knit beanie and a dark hoodie or jacket. The car interior is dark with clean modern trim, while the large glass sunroof dominates the scene and reveals a bright clear blue sky above. Bare and lightly budding tree branches stretch across the background outside, suggesting early spring. Small cards and stickers are visible near the sunroof glass, adding realism and casual everyday detail. Natural daylight, soft shadows, realistic smartphone photography, spontaneous composition, slightly tilted framing, calm mood, high realism, urban casual aesthetic.

## Rövidebb változat

Young man taking a candid selfie inside a car with a panoramic sunroof, half face visible, black beanie, dark clothing, clear blue sky overhead, tree branches outside, natural daylight, realistic smartphone photo, casual everyday vibe.

## Ha generáláshoz kell

Ha Midjourney / SDXL / Flux jellegű prompt kell, ezt érdemes használni:

**Generative prompt:**

realistic candid smartphone selfie, inside a car, panoramic sunroof, low angle shot, half of a young man’s face visible on the right side, black beanie, light stubble, dark hoodie, clear blue sky through glass roof, tree branches overhead, natural daylight, casual urban mood, off-center composition, slightly tilted framing, high realism, authentic car interior details, soft natural shadows, photorealistic

**Negative prompt:**

blurry face, deformed eyes, extra facial features, duplicated face, distorted car interior, unrealistic lighting, oversaturated colors, cartoon, painting, low detail, bad anatomy, fake skin texture, CGI look

## Testreszabás

Ha szeretnéd, át tudom írni ezt külön:
fotórealisztikus portré prompttá,  
cinematic prompttá,  
streetwear/Instagram stílusú prompttá,  
vagy pontosan Midjourney, Flux vagy SDXL formátumra.

entries.answer:
Persze — itt a **módosított prompt**, úgy átírva, hogy csak a karakter változzon fehér hajú fiúra, minden más maradjon az eredeti képleírás logikája szerint, és a haj jól látszódjon. A Gemini 3 Pro Image / Nano Banana Pro esetén a hivatalos útmutatók szerint a legjobb eredményt a természetes nyelvű, nagyon konkrét, egyértelmű szerkezetű promptok adják, különösen akkor, ha pontosan megadod a subjectet, a kompozíciót, a világítást, a környezetet és az editálási korlátokat.[1][2][3][4]
## Optimalizált prompt
Create an ultra-realistic candid smartphone selfie taken inside a modern car with a panoramic sunroof, shot from a low upward angle. Keep the exact same composition, environment, framing, mood, camera perspective, lighting behavior, background elements, car interior details, and overall everyday realism as before. The scene must still be dominated by the large glass sunroof, with a bright clear blue sky visible above and thin tree branches outside, suggesting early spring. Keep the image slightly tilted, casually framed, and naturally imperfect like a real spontaneous phone photo, with the subject positioned on the right edge of the frame and only part of the upper body and face visible.[2][3][4]

Change only the character: replace the previous person with a young white-haired boy, photographed in the same candid way. He should have very light white hair with a soft cool tone, thick and clearly visible, styled upward and slightly to the side so the hairstyle is fully readable at a glance. The hair must not be hidden by any hat, hood, crop, shadow, or motion blur; it should be one of the most visually legible features in the image. Show distinct strand separation, subtle root direction, realistic density, soft natural lift, fine flyaway hairs, and believable texture where daylight from above passes gently across the hair surface

Igazad van. Geminihez jobb, ha a prompt **eleve kész jelenetként** van megírva, nem úgy, mintha egy meglévő leírást szerkesztenénk; a Google útmutatói is azt hangsúlyozzák, hogy természetes, összefüggő mondatokkal, világos subjecttel, kompozícióval, fénnyel és korlátokkal érdemes promptolni.[1][2][3]

## Javított prompt

An ultra-realistic candid smartphone selfie of a young white-haired boy sitting inside a modern car with a panoramic sunroof, photographed from a low upward angle. The composition is slightly tilted and naturally imperfect, with the subject positioned on the right edge of the frame so only the right half of his face and part of his upper body are visible, preserving the casual spontaneous feeling of a real everyday phone photo. The large glass sunroof dominates the scene above him, revealing a bright clear blue sky and thin early-spring tree branches outside, while subtle stickers and cards near the sunroof glass remain visible for realistic lived-in detail. The lighting is natural daylight coming from above through the panoramic roof, creating soft realistic shadows, gentle facial modeling, and clean highlights without looking studio-lit or artificially enhanced.[2][4][1]

The boy has very light white hair that is fully visible and clearly readable, with no hat, hood, or crop hiding it. His hair is thick, soft, and airy, styled upward and slightly to the side with visible strand separation, fine flyaway hairs, realistic density, clean edges around the hairline, and subtle texture variation where the daylight catches the top layers; the hairstyle must be one of the most noticeable features in the image. His face is slim and youthful with a narrow jawline, a smooth tapered chin, a straight delicate nose, defined dark eyebrows, deep-set almond-shaped brown eyes, soft lower eyelids, natural faint under-eye shadows, a calm neutral expression, closed relaxed lips with a slightly fuller lower lip, pale natural skin, subtle cheek hollows, realistic skin texture, very light facial softness with no heavy beard, and anatomically accurate proportions. The ears, temple area, forehead transition, and eye spacing should all look natural and believable, with crisp eye detail, realistic pores, soft lip texture, and no plastic skin effect.[5][1][2]

He is wearing dark male streetwear in the same casual style as before: a dark zip-up jacket or bomber-style outerwear with a simple clean silhouette, minimal detailing, and realistic fabric folds. The clothing should remain understated and modern so the face and white hair stay dominant, while the black or very dark fabric contrasts naturally against the bright sky above. Keep the car interior dark and modern, keep the same candid urban everyday mood, and preserve the sense that this is a real front-camera phone shot rather than a polished fashion editorial. Prioritize photorealism, believable anatomy, authentic smartphone optics, natural skin texture, true-to-life lighting, and extremely convincing hair rendering.[3][1][5]

## Geminihez finomított változat

A Gemini 3 Pro Image / Nano Banana Pro promptnál különösen jól működik, ha a leírás nem kulcsszóhalmaz, hanem koherens jelenet, és pontosan rögzíti, mi legyen hangsúlyos; itt ez a fehér haj, az arc finom részletei, a telefonos selfie-kompozíció és a természetes fény. Emiatt ezt a rövidebb, feszesebb verziót is használhatod:[1][2][3]

Ultra-realistic smartphone selfie of a young white-haired boy inside a modern car with a panoramic sunroof, low upward angle, slightly tilted candid framing, right half of the face visible on the right edge of the frame, bright clear blue sky above, thin early-spring tree branches visible through the glass roof, dark modern car interior, natural daylight from above, soft realistic shadows, authentic everyday atmosphere. The boy has fully visible thick white hair styled upward and slightly sideways with detailed strands and fine flyaway hairs, dark defined eyebrows, large deep brown eyes, slim nose, narrow face, soft cheek hollows, pale natural skin, realistic pores, relaxed lips, youthful masculine features, no hat, no hood, no hidden hair. He wears a dark male zip-up jacket in a clean casual streetwear style. Photorealistic, extremely realistic facial anatomy, true smartphone camera feel, realistic skin texture, realistic hair detail, no beauty filter, no cartoon effect, no surreal distortion.[4][2][1]

## Negatív prompt

no hat, no hood covering hair, no cropped hair, no bald fade, no exaggerated anime features, no glossy plastic skin, no over-sharpening, no beauty filter, no extra facial features, no asymmetrical eyes, no warped jaw, no distorted ears, no fake beard texture, no melted background, no artificial studio glamour, no oversaturated colors, no CGI look, no painterly effect, no blur on hair, no messy hair silhouette, no deformed hands, no duplicated features[6][3]

Ha akarod, megírom ebből a **brutálisan maximalista Gemini-verziót** is, még részletesebb arc-, haj-, kamera- és fényparaméterezéssel.
